svg.title: Patent Intelligence Platform - Horizontal Relational Schema
svg.desc: All 23 relations appear once as horizontal attribute rows. Underlines indicate primary keys; numbered arrows connect foreign-key columns to actual referenced primary-key columns.
svg.text: Each table appears once. Underlined attributes form the primary key. Arrows point from FK columns to their referenced PK columns.
Matching small numbers identify the two ends of each continuous arrow. Small jumps indicate crossings, not connections.
Independent throttle counters; no foreign keys.
Blue: patent references | Purple: catalog references | Green: account/role references | Ochre: analysis references
23 tables, 101 attributes, 23 foreign keys. Every arrow is continuous between actual columns; number tags are not attributes.
All underlined attributes in a relation together form its primary key. Source: database/sql/01_schema.sql and 05_auth.sql.
